title: Multi Stain Graph Fusion for Multimodal Integration in Pathology
method: CNN-GNN stain branches with graph fusion.
main_findings: Stain-specific graph representations are combined without spatial slide registration.
limitations: Workshop study of liver ordinal scores, not cardiac binary rejection.
Review covers the cited pages; quantitative tables require further source verification.
does_not_establish: No gain established for cardiac H&E/IHC event-level MIL.
relevance_to_project: Comparator for combining nonregistered event slides.
